Typecheck passes clean.

`shape="rounded"` is now on `Button` in `apps/www/components/ui/button.tsx:36`:

```tsx
shape: {
  default: "",
  rounded: "rounded-full in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-full",
},
```

- Declared after `size` so its `rounded-full` wins over the per-size radii (`rounded-md`, `rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),8px)]`) via tailwind-merge.
- Includes the `in-data-[slot=button-group]` override too, since that variant-prefixed class is merged separately — without it, a rounded button inside a `ButtonGroup` would snap back to `rounded-md`.
- Defaults to `"default"`, so existing usage is unchanged.

Icon sizes (`icon`, `icon-sm`, …) become circles with it, as expected.
